candidateBinding.approvalBinding: An approval must name the exact PR commit SHA and these lockfile hashes.

enforcement.currentBehavior: Every active advisory still fails CI. This proposal is not loaded by the gate.
enforcement.withdrawnAdvisories: Require primary-source withdrawal evidence and an exact advisory ID; withdrawal is not a risk exception.
enforcement.releaseEvidence: Retain raw root, site and clean packed-consumer audits, tool versions, commit SHA, lock hashes, dependency owners, test results and reviewer disposition.

exceptionRequirements.approval: Only Judah may explicitly approve each exception; a PR, draft record or green test is not approval.
requiredFields: package, exact versions, dependency paths and affected scope
reason a compatible fix is unavailable
owner, follow-up ticket, review date and UTC expiry
Judah approval URL and approval timestamp
exceptionRequirements.expiryBehavior: Fail closed on expiry, missing approval, scope/version/lock drift, new reachability or new advisory. No automatic renewal.
exceptionRequirements.activation: A separately reviewed implementation must validate the approved records. No pending entry can suppress a finding.
exceptionRequirements.recheck: Re-audit every PR and release candidate; re-evaluate exposure when callers, deployment or dependencies change.

exceptionRequests.boundary: Deeply nested glob AST compilation can exhaust the stack. A controlled small-stack trigger reproduces the defect.
exceptionRequests.compatibilityBlocker: The primary advisory and registry list no patched release; upgrading to current 3.0.3 cannot fix it.
controlsProposed: Use reviewed repository glob/watch configuration only
Do not expose dev/watch tooling as a public service
Run untrusted PR builds without privileged credentials
exceptionRequests.uncertainty: Build-tool classification does not prove every transitive caller rejects attacker-controlled patterns.

exceptionRequests.boundary: Pre-existing prototype pollution can make mathematical rendering inherit trust settings and emit unsafe links/resources.
exceptionRequests.compatibilityBlocker: Patched 0.18.2 crosses Mermaid's 0.16 range. KaTeX 0.18 changes internal CSS class names; visual migration is outside this no-frontend task.
controlsProposed: Restrict CMS content editing to trusted editors
Do not enable trusted math rendering for untrusted expressions
Treat prototype-pollution findings as an unresolved prerequisite, not an independent harmless issue
exceptionRequests.uncertainty: The advisory is a gadget requiring another pollution source; no universal absence of such a source is claimed.
exceptionRequests.owner: Release Captain; Judah owns renderer migration approval
